article.title: Clorox分享AI創意工作方式：投放期間按消費者訊號調整素材
article.title_en: Clorox describes using AI signals to revise creative while campaigns are live
article.summary: Clorox在10月26日文章分享CMO Eric Schwartz於ANA Masters of Marketing的觀點：結合消費者洞察、AI與合作夥伴，讓素材在投放期間持續調整。這是工作方法案例，並非當日新產品發布。
article.summary_en: In an October 26 post, Clorox shared CMO Eric Schwartz’s ANA Masters of Marketing remarks on combining consumer insight, AI and partners to revise live creative. This is a workflow case, not a new product launch.

article.why_en: Teams can connect listening, production and approval into a repeatable loop. Seasonal campaigns can plan adaptable creative elements before launch.

article.detail:
Clorox在10月26日文章分享CMO Eric Schwartz於ANA Masters of Marketing的觀點：結合消費者洞察、AI與合作夥伴，讓素材在投放期間持續調整。這是工作方法案例，並非當日新產品發布。

Clorox表示PURE團隊以AI訊號了解過敏季節中引起考慮的使用場景，並在毋須重拍下修改素材。

文章把社交聆聽視為產品與內容學習來源，並強調人員、AI及夥伴共同參與。

案例提醒品牌把聆聽、製作與審批連成循環。對季節性活動，預先準備可調整的場景與素材版本，可能比等投放後檢討更實用。

選一項投放中的素材，定義可觸發改稿的訊號、批准人及衡量基準，避免只因短期波動頻繁改動。

案例為品牌自述；本刊未核實成本節省或銷售因果關係，也不將其他品牌的表現歸功於AI。
article.detail_en:
In an October 26 post, Clorox shared CMO Eric Schwartz’s ANA Masters of Marketing remarks on combining consumer insight, AI and partners to revise live creative. This is a workflow case, not a new product launch.

Clorox says its PURE team used AI signals about allergy-season occasions to update creative without a reshoot.

The post frames social listening as input to content and product learning, combining people, AI and partners.

Teams can connect listening, production and approval into a repeatable loop. Seasonal campaigns can plan adaptable creative elements before launch.

For one live asset, define the signal, approver and measurement baseline that would justify a revision, avoiding reactions to short-term noise.

This is a brand account. Cost savings and sales causation were not verified, and other brand outcomes are not attributed to AI.
